meta.name: full-output-enforcement
meta.description: Overrides default LLM truncation behavior. Enforces complete code generation, bans placeholder patterns, and handles token-limit splits cleanly. Apply to any task requiring exhaustive, unabridged output.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 强制生成完整代码，禁止占位符截断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常遇到LLM输出被截断或出现占位符的问题
copy.tagline_en: Force complete code generation, ban placeholder truncation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face LLM output truncation or placeholder issues

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会强制输出完整内容，不会用省略号或“此处省略”等占位符，也不会只给代码骨架。如果输出过长，会在自然断点处暂停并提示继续。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 生成完整代码、文件或多个组件时触发。

say.text: 请给我一个完整的Python脚本，不要省略任何部分。
say.note: Claude 会输出完整代码，不会用省略号或占位符。

say.text: 列出5个示例，每个都要完整。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will enforce complete output, never using placeholders like '...' or 'rest of code', and will not output skeletons. If output is long, it will pause at a clean breakpoint and prompt to continue.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to generate complete code, files, or multiple deliverables.

say_en.text: Give me a complete Python script, no omissions.
say_en.note: Claude will output full code without placeholders.
Claude will generate all 5 examples, not just one with 'similar for the rest'.
